sentences.text: The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 436/2021, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Malviya Nagar.
2. The marriage between petitioner no.1/husband and respondent no.2/wife was solemnized on 08.11.2019 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
3. No child was born out of the said wedlock.
4. Due to matrimonial differences between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2, the parties started residing separately from 09.10.2020.

Malviya Nagar.
8. The complainant/respondent No.2 states that the matter has been settled with the petitioners and she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
She further states that all the terms of the MOU have been complied with.
9. Learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State submits that investigation in the present FIR is pending and chargesheet is yet to be filed.
In view of the settlement between the parties, he also has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
